item.title: Trump and RFK Jr. try again to upend vaccines for kids
item.description: President Trump signed an executive order on Monday about vaccines, saying children should get fewer. His administration has been blocked in the courts from changing the vaccine schedule.
item.content:encoded:
President Trump signed an executive order on Monday about vaccines, saying children should get fewer. His administration has been blocked in the courts from changing the vaccine schedule.

item.title: People with disabilities say Medicaid income limits can stifle career advancement
item.description: Medicaid will have new work requirements next year. But some people with disabilities, who already work, say they'd like to work more, but risk losing their Medicaid coverage if they earn too much.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: It's been a record summer for foodborne illness
item.description: Heat and tainted produce have made this a record summer for foodborne illness. Cases of cyclosporiasis have topped 10,000, and the CDC just traced a new salmonella outbreak to Mexican jalapeños.
item.content:encoded: Heat and tainted produce have made this a record summer for foodborne illness. Cases of cyclosporiasis have topped 10,000, and the CDC just traced a new salmonella outbreak to Mexican jalapeños.

item.title: Federal funds can't be used to give test strips to drug users, raising overdose fears
item.description: Drug addiction groups are reeling after Trump officials said federal grants cannot be used to hand out test strips to drug users. The strips help users check street drugs for dangerous adulterants.

item.title: Infections from raw milk have sickened more than 100 in Idaho
item.description: Cyclosporiasis has been getting all the headlines, but infections from raw milk have sickened more than 100 in Idaho this summer.

item.title: A new vaccine could vanquish a major cause of deadly diarrheal disease
item.description: Over 1 million people a year die from diarrheal disease. Nearly half are kids under age 5. A new vaccine in trials offers great hope.

item.title: Kalshi and Polymarket bets on clinical trials criticized as 'ghastly'
item.description: Researchers warn betting on clinical trials could incentivize insider trading and interfere with drug development. But Kalshi and Polymarket say they provide valuable information to patients.
